title: Micron Deepens AI Memory Bet With Singapore Expansion And Enterprise Shift
text: Micron Technology (NasdaqGS:MU) is sharpening its focus on high-bandwidth memory for AI data centers. The company is exiting the consumer memory market to prioritize enterprise and AI infrastructure customers. Micron is expanding in Singapore with a planned US$24b advanced wafer fabrication facility.
